$comment: Humans and workloads share one identity model (schema.sql: principal).
The two fields that carry safety weight are `role` and `trust_domain`.
role       -> policy ROLE_TIER: auditor R0, sim R1, agent R2, operator R3,
approver/admin R4. Nobody gets R5; R5 is prohibited outright.
trust_domain -> policy SIMULATION_BARRIER: any principal in 'sim' is refused
every production tool at the gateway, with an audit event.
